lines.en: label day139:
scene chikafirstlust1
I sit alone in my office and wait for the day to come to an end, just as I always do after I finish “teaching,” if that’s what we’re still calling it.
The only difference is that, this time, I actually have an appointment.
Or at least...I thought I did?
Right before I made my way to the office, Chika ran over and grabbed one of the sleeves of my shirt to ask me if I was doing counseling stuff today.
Having no reason to lie to her (And perhaps wanting her company), I of course told her yes.
But I’ve been in here for around an hour already and I’m beginning to lose hope.
Woe is me.
: Sensei, are you still here?
: Sorry I took mega-long and stuff. I had to go give something to Yumi and she was just hanging out at some park for whatever reason.
Oh, cool. Woe isn’t me. Chika is here after all.
I wonder what the reason for the visit is, though?
: I’m still here. You can come in.
: Kay~ Pardon the intrusion.
: Ooooh nice place you got here!
Chika enters the room and quickly scans the hallway for some indiscernible reason.
And then she locks the door?
scene chikafirstlust2
: Heya.
: Hey. What’s up? And why did you lock the door?
: Hm? Lock the door? I guess I just did it out of instinct.
: But the door to your dorm room is never-
scene chikafirstlust3
: This place is like, super fancy for a counseling room, Sensei.
: I’m kinda jealous you get to hang out somewhere like this on a daily basis.
: There’s no reason to be jealous. I’m normally just alone anyway.
scene chikafirstlust4
: Wait, really? What’s even the point of you being the guidance counselor then?
: I guess for rare occasions like this where someone needs help or something.
: Hm? Who needs help?
: I assumed you did since you asked to see me after class.
scene chikafirstlust2
: Oh, nope! I just wanted to be alone with you for a little while and figured reserving a spot was the best way to get that done.
: You really like me enough to reserve a spot with me under the guise of having personal problems or issues or whatever it is counselors help with?
scene chikafirstlust3
: Idunno. I guess I do if I showed up, right?
It’s slightly embarrassing when she’s so nonchalant about it...But I guess it makes sense.
Chika and I have had a pretty natural progression to our relationship thus far, so it’s not like I’m going to complain about being alone with her.
scene chikafirstlust2
: So like...is there really nothing to do in here? You don’t have a TV or anything like that?
: Well, not like it really matters to me, but I’m guessing there’s nothing to do in here since it’s also the room where detentions take place.
scene chikafirstlust4
: Ah, yeah. I think Yumi said something about that once. How you kinda just make her stand there and stare at her or whatever.
scene chikafirstlust5
: I’m sure that was just an exaggeration, though. And whatever it was that landed her in here, I’m sure she deserved it.
: Most likely, yeah.
That’s...kind of odd, though. I’ve only seen Yumi in here a couple times throughout the year and it’s never been for more than a few minutes.
And I certainly don’t recall just making her stand there and staring at her.
scene chikafirstlust6
: Hey...Come to think of it, wasn’t I supposed to have detention a while ago?
: You? Why would someone like you ever have detention?
scene chikafirstlust7
if chikadetention == False:
: You know...cause I'm like...a bad girl and stuff.
: You're actually one of the most well-behaved girls in class when you cut out all of the time you spend on your phone.
: Come on...Just go along with it, jerk.
: Well, if that's what you want...
else:
: Well like, I’m sure it wasn’t real detention or anything, but we kinda joked about it in the dressing room that one time and-
: I don’t know. I guess I was kinda hoping you’d actually follow through with it...or whatever.
Now that she mentions it, I do vaguely remember saying something like that in the dressing room.
If I had known she’d been looking forward to it, though, I would have made this happen a long, long time ago.
: Why don't we have your detention right now, then?
scene chikafirstlust6
: Right now?
: Sure. You’re not in the office much to begin with, and I’d say you’re pretty overdue at this point. Wouldn’t you agree?
scene chikafirstlust8
: I suppose I am. And as the oldest member of our class, I have to set a good example and accept my punishment.
: In fact, I’ll let you double my punishment as a special offer for today and today only!
: I can’t tell if you’re trying to be seductive or trying to sell me something.
scene chikafirstlust9
: Yeah, that sounded a lot sexier in my head. I don’t know where the sales pitch came from.
: Too much mall stuff, I guess.
: I guess so. It’s nice that you were trying to be sexy, though. Thanks for that.
scene chikafirstlust10
: Wait, hold on a sec. You thanking me makes me feel totally weird. Like you’re just shrugging off my flirting.
: Do my words not affect you anymore now that we’ve-
: Chika.
: What?!
: You’re in detention. No talking.
: Wait, it’s a real detention?! This whole time I thought it was a euphemism for other stuff!
: Chika...
: Sensei!
scene black
jump chikafirstlustx
label chikafirstlustx:
I point to the couch behind her and she looks back and forth between it and me, trying to wrap her head around what’s going on.
Of course I’m not planning on actually making her stay quiet while we’re in here. I just think it might be fun pushing her buttons a bit.
Especially after she fell so easily for the whole “You’re a pervert” thing when I fingered her for the first time.
scene chikafirstlust11
: Hmph!
Only two minutes have passed, but Chika has not broken eye contact with me the entire time.
: What did you think detention entailed exactly?
: I don’t know, but it sure as heck wasn’t actual detention.
: Chika, take a second to think about what you just said.
scene chikafirstlust12
: No. How about you take a second to think about your actions?
: How the heck are you gonna get all close to a girl in a dressing room and be like “See me after class” or whatever and not expect her to think things are gonna happen.
: So you want things to happen?
: Of course I want things to happen.
scene chikafirstlust13
: I like you and it’s not fair that I’m the only one who ever gets to have any fun.
scene chikafirstlust12
: Also I’m pretty sure your penis is huge from the one time I touched it and not knowing that for a fact is driving me insane.
: Oh and also, I’m not perverted. And you’re being a jerk.
: Is this a Chika Chosokabe temper tantrum? I have to say, I thought you were a little more mature than this.
scene chikafirstlust14
: A temper tantrum? Sure. If that’s what you want to call it. But to me it just seems like you’re afraid of doing something with a student in your office.
: I can assure you that is most definitely not the case.
: Then what is the case, Sensei? Do you want me to beg?
: On the contrary. I just think it’s fun to mess around with you.
: I was actually just about to sit down before you started scowling at me.
scene chikafirstlust15
: Uhh...Oh.
: Well, now I certainly feel dumb.
scene chikafirstlust16
: But I guess...I am a little relieved that you're not bored of me yet.
: I’ll never get bored of you if you keep turning red like that. You are normally pretty mature, but you have quite the cute side sometimes, Chika.
scene chikafirstlust17
: Thanks...but, umm, now that you’re being forward about it, I kinda have no idea what to do.
: What do you mean?
: I mean I’m clearly not as much of a seductress as I thought I would be. And now you’re the one seducing me instead.
: I’m not seducing you, I’m just being honest.
scene chikafirstlust18
: Honest?
I take a seat next to Chika on the couch and rest my arm behind her. She immediately moves in closer despite currently being a bit more timid than she normally is.
Her face turns a darker shade of red as she looks into my eyes.
: I’m being honest when I say you’re cute. And that I won’t get bored of you.
: Good. You better not. Because I wouldn’t have let you touch me if I thought you were just gonna bail on me once you found someone else.
: Someone like me bailing on someone like you isn’t exactly something that happens every day. That won’t happen.
: I might not be the smartest guy out there, but I’m not an idiot.
: That’s right...
scene chikafirstlust19
: You’d be the biggest idiot in the whole world.
: A huge idiot.
: A massive idiot...
Understanding where this is going, I elect to do what any sane man would do in my position and stay silent, waiting for her to inevitably make her move.
: Senseiiii~
: Yes?
: Can I...take it out? Please?
: I wanna see it.
: I’m not opposed.
: Really? Cause the one time I tried, you pushed me down and took my finger-virginity.
: Finger-virginity isn’t a thing, Chika.
: Shut up, yes it is. Now show me your penis.
: Someone is certainly assertive today.
: Yes. And that someone is about to take your pants off, so please bear with me.
scene black
Chika lays down beside me on the couch and unzips my pants, sliding them down shortly after.
Well, she tries to slide them down, at least. She can only reach one side, so I have to assist her.
And then...
scene chikafirstlust20
: HOLY FUCK!
: Yeah, I was more or less expecting that reaction.
: DUDE!
: That will be inside of you one day.
scene chikafirstlust21
: Me?! How?! That’s literally impossible!
: I don’t know. We’ll figure something out.
scene chikafirstlust22
: Uhhhh yeah, I don’t know about that.
: I’m pretty sure I’d actually die.
: I’ll just give you handjobs or something for the rest of eternity.
: You’ll cave. I can feel it.
: Jesus Christ it’s bigger than my little sister.
: Okay, it’s not that big...
scene chikafirstlust23
: How does my hand feel?
: Extremely soft. And warm.
: Thanks. I use moisturizer.
: That’s...nice.
: Yeah, the really expensive kind. Yumi stole it from some flea market and gave it to me as a birthday present.
: Is this your idea of dirty-talk? Because it’s definitely a strange strategy.
scene chikafirstlust24
: What? Talking about my hands doesn’t turn you on?
: I...don’t think so.
: Then what would turn you on, Sensei?
: Well, for one...not calling me Sensei anymore would help.
scene chikafirstlust25
: Wait, really? Then...what would you like me to call you instead?
: How about...
